description: This file contains shell functions used for managing artifacts, paths, git worktrees, and related tasks within a project. It includes utility functions for handling documentation, tests, artifacts, and repository operations, likely part of build or CI scripts.

methods.name: require_artifact
methods.description: Checks if the specified artifact at path exists and is non-empty, exits if not.

methods.name: path_is_docsish
methods.description: Determines if a given path is a documentation or markdown related file.

methods.name: path_is_testish
methods.description: Determines if a given path appears to be a test file or directory.

methods.name: path_is_maintainer_workflow_only
methods.description: Checks if a path belongs to maintainer workflow scripts or directories.

methods.name: file_list_is_docsish_only
methods.description: Checks if all files in a list are documentation or markdown files.

methods.name: changelog_required_for_changed_files
methods.description: Determines if a changelog is needed based on the list of changed files, ignoring docs and tests.

methods.name: print_review_stdout_summary
methods.description: Outputs a summary of a review based on review files.

methods.name: print_relevant_log_excerpt
methods.description: Filters and outputs relevant error messages from logs.

methods.name: print_unrelated_gate_failure_guidance
methods.description: Provides guidance on unrelated CI gate failures based on labels.

methods.name: run_quiet_logged
methods.description: Runs a command quietly, logs output, and reports success or failure with logs.

methods.name: bootstrap_deps_if_needed
methods.description: Checks and installs dependencies if necessary.

methods.name: wait_for_pr_head_sha
methods.description: Polls until a pull request's head SHA matches an expected value, with retries.

methods.name: is_author_email_merge_error
methods.description: Detects if a commit message indicates an author email error.

methods.name: merge_author_email_candidates
methods.description: Generates a list of candidate author emails for merging, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: common_repo_root
methods.description: Determines the root directory of the repository.

methods.name: worktree_path_for_branch
methods.description: Finds the worktree path associated with a specific branch.

methods.name: worktree_is_registered
methods.description: Checks if a worktree path is registered with git.

methods.name: resolve_existing_dir_path
methods.description: Resolves the absolute path of an existing directory.

methods.name: is_repo_pr_worktree_dir
methods.description: Checks if a directory is a PR worktree.

methods.name: remove_worktree_if_present
methods.description: Removes a git worktree if it exists, with safety checks.

methods.name: delete_local_branch_if_safe
methods.description: Deletes a local branch if it is safe to do so (not checked out in a worktree).
